name: Transwestern Gas Pipeline / San Juan Lateral Expansion (2008)
researcher_notes: Checked against the existing United States gas roster. Only the Transwestern parent row P0273 (main line, 4,345 mi) and the proposed Desert Southwest Expansion row P7840 exist. No row covers this 2008 San Juan lateral expansion, so it is not a match to an existing row. It is a separate project from the 2005 San Juan expansion (FERC docket CP04-104). The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 514, lists TW San Juan Lateral Expansion: completed, in service 2008, New Mexico, 25 miles, 36 inch, 375 MMcf/d added, FERC docket CP06-459. 25 miles is about 40 km, which meets the 25 km length rule. The sponsor is Transwestern Pipeline Company, owned by Energy Transfer. Owner and parent are left blank here because no ref states them; the parent row uses ETP Legacy and Energy Transfer Operating LP. This is one source only (EIA). I could not reach a FERC order for CP06-459 in this session because web search was unavailable, so a second source is still wanted. Start and end towns are not sourced and are left blank. The state, New Mexico, comes from EIA. No route was found. Capacity is the added capacity of the expansion.
